title: Can a Potato Beat a Banana for Potassium?

scenes.text: Why 1 medium potato can outshine a banana in potassium?
scenes.query: medium potato potassium compared to banana

scenes.text: A medium potato (≈150 g) contains about 620 mg potassium.
A banana of similar size provides roughly 450 mg potassium.
Surprise: the potato gives you more potassium than the banana!
scenes.query2: which has more potassium potato or banana

description: Discover why the humble potato packs a potassium punch that beats bananas. Simple swap, big benefit – follow for more practical nutrition tips.
